The '''Sennex system''' was located in the [[Lorelli Reach]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lorell Route]] to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia]] and [[Daruvvia system/Legends|Daruvvia systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Sennex [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Sennex|Sennex pirates]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sennex system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
